Story Dice Roller

Roll 9 story dice covered in symbols — then weave every symbol into an improvised story. A creativity workout for writers and kids.

Tap any die to re-roll just that one. Use every symbol in your story!

📖 How to use

  1. Tap “Roll the dice”.
  2. Look at all 9 symbols.
  3. Make up a story that uses every symbol.
  4. Tap a single die to re-roll it, or copy the prompt.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many dice and symbols are there?

Nine dice, each with 6 faces — 54 symbols total, from 🚀 and 🐉 to 🗝️ and 🌈.

Can I re-roll one die?

Tap any single die to re-roll just that one while keeping the rest.

Does it give me a story prompt?

Yes — use the generated prompt line as a story starter and copy it.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes — big tappable dice, fully mobile friendly.
